edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, making the transaction origin the authorization authority.
owner state variable is written from the untrusted tx.origin value.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is stored into the botProtection state variable.
Constructor writes the botProtection address used later for external calls.
Constructor stores uniPair derived from the pair computation.
Constructor invokes pairForUniswap to derive the pair address.
wrappedBinance is passed as the base token for the pair computation.
routerForPancake receives an unlimited allowance from the constructor.
Constructor grants uint(-1) allowances to the router and to tx.origin on uniPair.
checkBots modifier performs the external call into botProtection.
The botProtection state address is the target of the low-level call.
uniPair is encoded into the bot protection call data.
checkBots parameter _from is forwarded into the external call data.
checkBots parameter _to is forwarded into the external call data.
checkBots parameter _value is forwarded into the external call data.
notABot receives the boolean success flag of the botProtection call.
The call result gates the modifier body through require(notABot).
transfer delegates its logic to transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as _from and is also compared against _from for allowance spending.
transfer parameter _to flows into transferFrom.
transfer parameter _value flows into transferFrom.
checkBots modifier executes before the transferFrom body.
_from selects the balance and allowance entries updated in transferFrom.
_to selects the credited balance entry in transferFrom.
_value is the amount moved between balances and allowance.
_from keys the balance entry decremented by unsafe arithmetic.
_to keys the balance entry incremented by unsafe arithmetic.
_value is subtracted from balance and allowance without SafeMath.
Unchecked -= and += results are written back into transferFrom state.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value use raw arithmetic.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read to authorize the transfer.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decremented by _value without SafeMath.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], letting callers set arbitrary allowances.
_spender keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
_value is stored directly as the allowance in approve.
approve updates the allowance state mapping.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner, an authorization check based on the caller.
owner state variable is used as the authorization reference in delegate.
delegate executes the low-level delegatecall operation.
Parameter a is the target contract of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Arbitrary delegatecall runs untrusted code in this contract's storage context and can re-enter.
list requires msg.sender == owner before distributing balances.
owner state variable guards the list function.
_numList is written into balanceOf[address(this)] in list.
_numList is forwarded as amountTokenDesired/amountTokenMin to the router call.
_reallyGoHere is encoded into the botProtection call data inside the loop.
_amounts participates in the same loop-driven external call sequence.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the router deadline, a miner-influenced value.
routerForPancake is the target of the addLiquidityETH external call.
External call to the router happens before subsequent balance state writes in list.
Arbitrary external botProtection call is made inside the balance-writing loop.
list assigns balanceOf[address(this)], balanceOf[msg.sender] and loop recipient balances.
Unchecked supply and balance arithmetic results are committed to list state.
_numList feeds the unchecked balance assignment arithmetic.
_amounts entries feed the unchecked balance assignment arithmetic.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 is computed with raw arithmetic in list.
Loop index i drives repeated unchecked balance writes.
botProtection state address is the target of the loop external call.
list reads botProtection when invoking the protection callback.
list reads routerForPancake to add liquidity.
tokenA parameter is used to order and hash the pair.
tokenB parameter is used to order and hash the pair.
tokenA becomes token0 or token1 depending on the ordering comparison.
tokenB becomes token1 or token0 depending on the ordering comparison.
token0 is hashed into the pair address.
token1 is hashed into the pair address.
Computed pair address is returned by pairForUniswap.
pairForUniswap result is assigned to uniPair in the constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter is immediately written into botProtection state and has no independent behaviour.
_from is only forwarded into the low-level botProtection call and carries no separate semantics.
_to is only forwarded into the low-level botProtection call and carries no separate semantics.
_value is only forwarded into the low-level botProtection call and carries no separate semantics.
Transfer parameter is trivially passed through to transferFrom as part of the transfer wrapper.
Transfer parameter is trivially passed through to transferFrom as part of the transfer wrapper.
_from only indexes balanceOf and allowance entries inside transferFrom.
_to only indexes the credited balance entry inside transferFrom.
_value is consumed by the balance and allowance updates inside transferFrom.
_spender only indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
_value is stored directly into the allowance mapping by approve.
Parameter a is the target address of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter b is the calldata supplied to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
tokenA is ordered/hashed only within the pure pair derivation helper.
tokenB is ordered/hashed only within the pure pair derivation helper.
_numList is used only for balance assignment and liquidity amount inside list.
Recipient array is used only for the botProtection call and the balance loop inside list.
Amount array is used only for the balance loop inside list.
notABot is solely the decoded success flag of the botProtection external call.
isNotBot is the raw return data buffer of the botProtection external call and is never validated.
pair is the return value local of the pure pair derivation helper.
token0 is a transient ordering local used only for the pair hash.
token1 is a transient ordering local used only for the pair hash.
Loop index i only drives the unchecked balance writes and Transfer events in list.
